The '''Zanbar Death Watch camp''' was a base established by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] on [[Zanbar/Legends|Zanbar]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], after relocating from [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]].

==History==

Sometime after the [[Skirmish on Florrum/Legends|disastrous duel]] on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]],<ref name="Revival">{{TCW|Revival (episode)}}</ref> [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] were found near dead by the Death Watch in their [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] and [[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan]] then took the two to their camp for medical treatment, where Maul received new [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Limb/Legends|legs]] and Opress received a cybernetic left arm. The two brothers would later ally with the Death Watch after seeing their aims were not so different.<ref name="Eminence" />

It was at this camp that [[Lom Pyke/Legends|Lom Pyke]] and his [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|allies]] approached Maul wishing to form an alliance with the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]]. Maul accepted and the Pyke family joined their ranks.<ref name="Eminence" />
